title.zh: SpaceX与特斯拉成立特别委员会探讨合并可能性
title.en: SpaceX and Tesla form special committees to explore potential merger

current_state.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX和特斯拉已成立独立的董事会委员会，探讨一项可能缔造约3.5万亿美元公司的合并，业务涵盖火箭、电动汽车、人形机器人、社交媒体和Grok AI聊天机器人。
current_state.en: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed independent board committees to explore a merger that could create a roughly $3.5 trillion company spanning rockets, electric vehicles, humanoid robots, social media, and the Grok AI chatbot.

updates.title_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉成立特别委员会，探讨合并可能性
updates.title_en: SpaceX与特斯拉成立特别委员会，探讨合并可能性
updates.what_changed_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉各自成立了独立董事特别委员会，探讨潜在合并事宜，埃隆·马斯克已回避，并指出任何交易都需获得50%特斯拉股东的批准。
updates.what_changed_en: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.
updates.current_state_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉各自成立了独立董事特别委员会，探讨潜在合并事宜，埃隆·马斯克已回避，并指出任何交易都需获得50%特斯拉股东的批准。
updates.current_state_en: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.

updates.title_zh: 马斯克称SpaceX与特斯拉合并是“好主意”，AI收入增长九倍
updates.title_en: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
updates.what_changed_zh: 马斯克公开表示SpaceX与特斯拉合并是“好主意”，并称双方特别委员会应股东要求讨论该想法；但他强调委员会尚未就交易条款达成一致，也不能保证会达成，且特斯拉侧需全部股份的50%支持。
updates.what_changed_en: Musk publicly said a SpaceX-Tesla merger is a 'good idea' and that special committees are discussing it at shareholder request, while stressing no terms have been agreed, no deal is guaranteed, and Tesla would need 50% of all shares to approve.
updates.current_state_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉的独立董事特别委员会正在探讨潜在合并；马斯克公开支持该想法但未参与讨论，交易条款尚未达成一致，且任何交易仍需获得特斯拉全部股份50%的批准。
updates.current_state_en: Special committees of independent directors at SpaceX and Tesla are exploring a potential merger; Musk publicly supports the idea but is recused, no terms have been agreed, and any deal would still require approval from 50% of all Tesla shares.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Elon Musk said a SpaceX-Tesla merger is a 'good idea' as special committees discuss the potential combination and SpaceX's AI business, SpaceXAI, became its largest revenue segment with ninefold growth.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Elon Musk said a SpaceX-Tesla merger is a 'good idea' as special committees discuss the potential combination and SpaceX's AI business, SpaceXAI, became its largest revenue segment with ninefold growth.
